_about: Public-domain Theodore Thornton Munger (1830-1910, New Haven Congregationalist, voice of the New Theology) for the Word Hoard: On the Threshold (1881), The Freedom of Faith (1883), Lamps and Paths (1885), The Appeal to Life (1887), Character through Inspiration (1897), Horace Bushnell, Preacher and Theologian (1899) and Essays for the Day (1904), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 32 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
